description: Land Acquisition - Thalangama-North, Kaduwela D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels (Lot No. 1 and Lot No. 2) for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is only in his capacity as the authority making the land acquisition declaration, and the core content is exclusively about land matters without detailing ministerial portfolio responsibilities. This fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters.
